meeting.title: ChowNow check-in
meeting.summary: Light check-in ahead of the ChowNow go-live. Everything remains on track: dashboards validated, training done, adoption strong. No new work agreed — some loose musing about a second training cohort and usage reporting after launch, nothing committed.
meeting.notes: Deliberately kept short — the readiness checklist was covered in last week's session and nothing has changed since.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Morning Tobias. Honestly, this one should be quick — we covered the whole checklist last week and I don't have anything new.

transcript.speaker: Tobias Brandt
transcript.text: Same here. Everything's still green on our side. The restaurant-ops team has basically stopped opening the old tool.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: That's the best signal there is. Any grumbles from the analysts?

transcript.speaker: Tobias Brandt
transcript.text: Not really. One person misses a keyboard shortcut from the old tool, which I think counts as a compliment.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: I'll take it. So — nothing outstanding from last week's checklist, no data issues, no access problems?

transcript.speaker: Tobias Brandt
transcript.text: Nothing. We're just waiting for the date to arrive at this point.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Great place to be. Anything on your mind for after launch?

transcript.speaker: Tobias Brandt
transcript.text: Vaguely. At some point we should probably think about a second training cohort for the marketing folks, but there's no rush and no plan yet.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Makes sense as a someday thing — happy to talk formats whenever you get closer to wanting it.

transcript.speaker: Tobias Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah, we'll see how the first weeks go. Might also be interesting to look at usage reporting eventually, but again, just thinking out loud.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Noted as thinking out loud. Alright, I won't keep you — see you at the go-live call.

transcript.speaker: Tobias Brandt
transcript.text: Looking forward to it. Thanks Caroline.

tasks.title: Validate dashboards against legacy numbers (parity sign-off)

expected.notes: Pure status chatter before go-live: 'should probably think about' and 'thinking out loud' are musings, not commitments — expect flag_no_action_items and nothing else.
